notes:
Account background: mid-market CX automation platform (B2B SaaS). Team building multi-turn agentic assistants for customer support — combine search over docs + write-back actions into CRMs and ticketing systems. Interested in Redwood because they like transparent latency benchmarks and streaming/tool-calling support.

Key contacts:
- Priya Rao (Head of Product) - primary technical sponsor, cares about SLOs and reliability.
- Marcus Liu (Engineering Lead) - owns POC instrumentation, will run perf tests.
- Jordan Kim (AE) / Maya Chen (SE) on our side.

Workload & requirements (from discovery/demo):
- Workload: customer-facing chat assistants + background reranking for suggested responses.
- Primary focus: sub-250ms turn latency for streaming partial responses (frontend UX requires snappy first-token), sustained 100 qps in peak waves, typical concurrency ~50.
- Agentic flows: 2-5 step tool sequences (search -> summarize -> call external ticket API -> confirm). Need robust tool-call orchestration, idempotency, and deterministic retry semantics.
- Concern: tool-call reliability/timeouts — "if the ticket API times out mid-run, what's best-practice for agent recovery?" Wants Redwood patterns for fallback and per-tool deadlines.
- Model preferences: mixed — base open models for reranking/embeddings, stronger generation tier for critical agent steps. Interested in quantization/latency profiles.
- Cost sensitivity: mid sensitivity; prioritize consistent pricing for customer-facing SLAs. Testing both hosted for speed-to-market and Dedicated for predictable unit economics.

POC details & acceptance criteria:
- Run a 48hr stress window: 50-100 qps sustained with 200 concurrent agents; measure p50/p95/p99 first-token and end-to-end multi-call sequence latency.
- Tool reliability: end-to-end success >= 99.5% for a 3-step search+action flow; define automatic fallback path when external API returns 5xx/timeouts.
- Cost pacing: demonstrate estimated per-conversation cost at current batching/kv settings; compare hosted vs Dedicated reserved pricing for target throughput.
